:::warning Destructive Without `ApiFlags: OnlySetMappedProperties`

Fields not included in the request body are overwritten with `null` or their default values. To update only the fields you provide and leave all others unchanged, include the header `ApiFlags: OnlySetMappedProperties` on every request.

:::

Updates an existing labor type identified by LaborTypeId. Allows modifying the labor type name, overtime flag, overtime multiplier, icon, and scope settings.

**Prerequisites**
1. **LaborTypeId** - Use [GET /api/v1.0/labor/types](/docs/api/labor-types/list-labor-types) to obtain the LaborTypeId from `Items[].LaborTypeId`.
2. **SiteId** (optional) - Use [GET /api/v1.0/sites](/docs/api/sites/list-sites) to obtain a SiteId when setting site-level scope.
3. **ProductId** (optional) - Use [GET /api/v1.0/products/all](/docs/api/products/list-products) to obtain a ProductId.

**Workflow Example**
1. Get the current labor type: [GET /api/v1.0/labor/types/\{LaborTypeId\}](/docs/api/labor-types/get-labor-type).
2. Modify the desired fields in the request body.
3. Submit: [POST /api/v1.0/labor/types/\{LaborTypeId\}](/docs/api/labor-types/update-labor-type).

**Minimal Required Fields**: `Name`
